pin.description: A budget hotel and hostel hybrid in central Leipzig, with private multi-bed family rooms, a shared guest kitchen, laundry and a lounge.

pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hotel and hostel hybrid in central Leipzig, with private multi-bed family rooms, a shared guest kitchen, laundry and a lounge.

Family and budget stay

Book a whole private family room and confirm the beds, occupancy and cot requirements. Shared dormitory beds are a different product. The guest kitchen, laundry and lounge can help with meals and longer stays; check equipment, house rules and charges.

The property is in central Leipzig near the main station. Plan the actual walk with children and luggage. Compare the full private-room rate, breakfast, taxes, parking, storage and cancellation terms for your dates.

Guest feedback

Guests praise the central location, helpful reception and breakfast. Other firsthand accounts describe dated furnishings, small rooms, outside noise and summer heat; older family accounts also raise cleaning concerns. Experiences vary by room and stay. Check recent feedback, ventilation and room position. Aggregate scores are a dated snapshot from 150 reviews.

Brand opening and conversion

MEININGER opened on 1 April 2017. The former parent company’s annual report confirms the completed opening and 404 beds, matching the day announced by the operator.

The project refurbished the former ibis Leipzig City, which had closed in March 2016. It is a brand conversion rather than an entirely new building. No conversion-specific investment was verified.

The current operator portfolio lists 126 rooms and 404 beds; this is current listed inventory, separate from availability for a particular stay.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-23: refreshed Tripadvisor UK snapshot 150 reviews, overall 4.1/5. Rooms 3.8, Service 4.3, Location 4.9, Cleanliness 4.3, Value 4.4 rounded to half steps. Janet Owen firsthand couple review September 2025, exact publication day unknown. Noise, dated rooms, heat and older cleaning complaints retained. MICHELIN Leipzig full 1–6 of 6 has no match; Forbes Leipzig unavailable, AAA excludes Germany. Acclaim null.

reviews.title: Highly recommended.
reviews.quote: A welcoming hotel. Reception Team excellent. Room very clean.

pin.longFormSummary:
A family resort in LaGrange, Georgia, with suites, indoor water-park access included with overnight stays, daily family activities and additional paid attractions.

Family water-park stay

Choose the exact suite, beds and booked occupancy. Confirm water-park hours, height rules, wristbands, supervision and arrival-day or departure-day access. MagiQuest, arcade games, passes, dining and parking can add to the bill. Compare all package conditions for your dates.

The operator lists 457 suites across eight suite types and a 100,000-square-foot water park. Some microwaves are shared rather than in each suite, and this lodge has no fitness centre. LaGrange is southwest of Atlanta; allow for the actual drive rather than assuming a downtown location.

Guest feedback

October guests describe clean rooms and an inviting atmosphere, alongside expensive dining, delayed towel requests and late room readiness. A September family account reports carpet odour, uncomfortable beds, missed housekeeping and dirty dining tables. These are individual guest experiences; check recent reviews and confirm the suite, service arrangements and full bill.

Formal opening and development

The resort celebrated its grand opening on 24 May 2018. The construction project profile records this completed event. Its older 456-suite and 93,000-square-foot water-park figures differ from the current operator description and are not combined into one inventory.

At the opening, the general manager told WTVM that Great Wolf Lodge had invested US$150 million in this project. This is the reported whole-project investment, separate from later spending and nightly room rates.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-23: refreshed Tripadvisor UK snapshot 1,572 reviews, overall 3.9/5. Rooms 4.1, Service 4.0, Location 4.3, Cleanliness 4.1, Value 3.5 rounded to half steps. Shequila O firsthand family review October 2026, exact day unknown. Dining costs, slow towels, room-readiness and September odour/housekeeping complaints retained. MICHELIN LaGrange unavailable; Forbes Atlanta no match; AAA LaGrange directory has no exact property match. Unverified Cvent AAA claim not scored; acclaim null.
